cases.title: Verify default panels loading
cases.description: Verify that default panels and their contents are successfully loaded into the Sidebar on startup.

cases.title: Verify sidebar maximum width constraint
cases.description: Verify that the maximum width of the Sidebar is approximately one third of the browser window size.

cases.title: Verify non-default sidebar width persistence
cases.description: Verify that a non-default width of the Sidebar is retained after a new window is opened or the browser is restarted.

cases.title: Verify mouse cursor icons on hover
cases.description: Verify that mouse cursors display the correct icon when mousing over interactive areas of the Sidebar.

cases.title: Verify panel highlight on hover
cases.description: Verify that panels appear highlighted when the mouse is moved over them.

cases.title: Verify sidebar toggle using grippy
cases.description: Verify that the Sidebar can be successfully opened and closed using the grippy control.

cases.title: Verify adding a panel to the sidebar
cases.description: Verify that a new panel can be successfully added to the sidebar.

cases.title: Verify preventing duplicate panel addition
cases.description: Verify that an already added panel cannot be added to the sidebar again.

cases.title: Verify deleting a single panel
cases.description: Verify that a specific panel can be deleted from the sidebar.

cases.title: Verify deleting all panels
cases.description: Verify that all panels can be cleared and deleted from the sidebar simultaneously.

cases.title: Verify listing remote panels
cases.description: Verify that all available remote panels are correctly listed.

cases.title: Verify listing local panels
cases.description: Verify that all available local panels are correctly listed.

cases.title: Verify panel preview before addition
cases.description: Verify that panels can be properly previewed prior to being added to the sidebar.

cases.title: Verify panel customization on the sidebar
cases.description: Verify that panels can be customized directly on the sidebar.

cases.title: Verify panel reordering on the sidebar
cases.description: Verify that panels can be reordered correctly on the sidebar.

cases.title: Verify cancellation of adding and reordering panels
cases.description: Verify that nothing changes after adding or reordering panels on the sidebar when the action is cancelled.

cases.title: Verify saving changes in order and panel list
cases.description: Verify that changes made to the order and panel list are correctly reflected and saved.

cases.title: Verify opening What's Related panel links
cases.description: Verify that links contained within the What's Related panels are opened in the browser.

cases.title: Verify opening Bookmarks panel links
cases.description: Verify that links contained within the Bookmarks panel are opened in the browser.

cases.title: Verify panel title visibility in Add menu
cases.description: Verify that the panel title shows up in the Add menu when a panel is added.

cases.title: Verify unselecting panels from Add menu
cases.description: Verify that unselecting panels from the Add menu removes those panels from the Sidebar.

cases.title: Verify adding a panel using JavaScript
cases.description: Verify that a panel can be successfully added to the sidebar using JavaScript.

opinions.feedback: The high-level test cases effectively cover all provided requirements with clear distinct scenarios, adequate testability, and appropriate risk management. No blockers or missing requirements were identified.
All test cases map correctly to the given requirements and comprehensively cover the functionality specified without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-144: Testable behavior is loading default panels and contents on startup; boundary is presence/absence of default panels; normal path is successful load; abnormal path is missing panels; ambiguity is exact definition of default panels. R-145: Testable behavior is max width constraint (~1/3 window); boundary is window width scaling; normal path is resizing up to 1/3; abnormal path is exceeding limit; ambiguity is 'approximately'. R-146: Testable behavior is persistence of non-default width across sessions/windows; boundary is browser restart and new window creation; normal path is width retained; abnormal path resets to default; no major ambiguities. R-147: Testable behavior is correct mouse cursor icons on hover; boundary is interactive vs non-interactive areas; normal path is correct icon (e.g., pointer, resize); abnormal path is default cursor; ambiguity is exact icon mapping. R-148: Testable behavior is panel visual highlight on hover; boundary is cursor enter/exit events; normal path is highlight applied; abnormal path is no visual change; ambiguity is highlight style. R-149: Testable behavior is opening/closing via grippy control; boundary is toggling state; normal path is sidebar opens/closes on click; abnormal path is grippy unresponsive; ambiguity is exact grippy definition. R-150: Testable behavior is adding a new panel; boundary is valid panel source; normal path is panel added; abnormal path is addition failure; ambiguity is source types. R-151: Testable behavior is preventing duplicate panel addition; boundary is panel already present in sidebar; normal path is duplication blocked/ignored; abnormal path is duplicate allowed; ambiguity is duplicate detection criteria. R-152: Testable behavior is deleting a single panel; boundary is existing panels; normal path is panel removed; abnormal path is panel persists; ambiguity is confirmation prompt behavior. R-153: Testable behavior is deleting all panels; boundary is sidebar with 1+ panels; normal path is all panels cleared; abnormal path is panels remain; ambiguity is default panel handling on clear. R-154: Testable behavior is listing remote panels; boundary is network availability/remote source; normal path is list populated; abnormal path is timeout/empty list; ambiguity is source endpoint. R-155: Testable behavior is listing local panels; boundary is local filesystem/storage; normal path is local list populated; abnormal path is failure to read local panels; ambiguity is local path. R-156: Testable behavior is previewing panels prior to addition; boundary is pre-add state; normal path is preview renders correctly; abnormal path is preview fails; ambiguity is preview UI mechanism. R-157: Testable behavior is customizing panels on sidebar; boundary is customizable properties; normal path is custom settings applied; abnormal path is customization ignored; ambiguity is allowed customizations. R-158: Testable behavior is reordering panels via drag/drop or UI; boundary is top/bottom limits of list; normal path is order updates; abnormal path is order reverts; ambiguity is reordering mechanism. R-159: Testable behavior is discarding changes on cancel; boundary is save vs cancel action; normal path is state reverts to pre-edit; abnormal path is changes persist; ambiguity is scope of cancellation. R-160: Testable behavior is committing order and panel list on save; boundary is save action trigger; normal path is changes permanently applied; abnormal path is changes lost; ambiguity is storage mechanism. R-161: Testable behavior is opening 'What's Related' links in browser; boundary is link click event; normal path is link opens in browser tab/window; abnormal path is link fails to open; ambiguity is target window/tab policy. R-162: Testable behavior is opening Bookmarks links in browser; boundary is bookmark click; normal path is link opens in browser; abnormal path is link fails; ambiguity is target window/tab policy. R-163: Testable behavior is panel title visibility in Add menu upon addition; boundary is panel added state; normal path is title appears in menu; abnormal path is title missing; ambiguity is menu structure. R-164: Testable behavior is removing panels from sidebar via Add menu unselection; boundary is checkbox/toggle in menu; normal path is panel removed from sidebar; abnormal path is panel stays; ambiguity is synchronization between menu and sidebar. R-165: Testable behavior is adding panel via JavaScript API; boundary is valid JS execution/permissions; normal path is panel added programmatically; abnormal path is script error/rejection; ambiguity is API signature.
